title: i18n(zh-CN): "pillar" translated as 支柱 with pillar names left in English; timezone settings keys missing
body:
**Filing gate ① — product defect with a named location and a reproduction.** reach: Studio in zh-CN, and first open of an app in en.

**Who acts on it:** objectui triage → the Studio / app-shell owner. ⛔ Not a claim. Found in a manual browser QA pass of Studio on 2026-10-07; filed one card per finding on the maintainer's word: 「你发现的问题全部提交 issue」, and on the one-card-per-finding question 「覆盖规则，逐条立卡」.

## What happens

- zh-CN strings translate "pillar" literally as 支柱 and leave pillar names in English: "这个软件包还没有对象 — 先到 Data 支柱创建。"
- The workspace-timezone prompt (first app open) logs at least 25 "[object-ui i18n] Missing translation for \"workspace|sidebar|user|organization|app.settings.localization.keys.timezone.*\" (language \"en\")" warnings; its help reads "IANA zone for today()/daysFromNow, analytics date buckets, and rendered datetimes."

## Suggested direction (triage to rule)

Use 数据 / 自动化 / 界面 (the zh tab labels already used) in all zh strings; add the timezone keys and an author-facing help line.

## Environment

objectstack `879bd38c` · `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` on an isolated port and SQLite file · objectui `179f6fe9` (HEAD; the framework pin `.objectui-sha` is `a58626c8`) served by the console's Vite dev server, perf numbers from a `vite build` of the same commit · Chromium 141 at 1440×900 · signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai` unless stated.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *zh-CN pillar translation 支柱 timezone missing translation keys*: 2 hits (0 open, 2 closed).
- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *zh-CN Studio untranslated strings English left in Chinese UI timezone settings*: 8 hits (0 open, 8 closed).

  - objectstack-ai/objectui#10862 (closed) — zh-CN designer leftovers family
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#10969 (closed) — zh-CN leftovers family
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11693 (closed) — timezone handling, but data plumbing not missing translation keys
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.
